data.name: Gnome Trickster (Mythic)
data.description:
Thanks to your mythic power, the magic in your blood has grown more potent and diverse. You gain the following spell-like abilities: 1/day--blur and vanish.
You can use your gnome spell-like abilities an additional times per day. You can spend these additional uses to use any of your gnome spell-like abilities you wish. Your caster level for your gnome spell-like abilities becomes.|HalfMythicLevel
